peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 1% below its local comparables; 28 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (42.3): 2.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 37 of 91 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 66.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,204,000 ($1,265 psf, 936–1,054 sq ft; 8 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,161 psf (range $1,027–1,348); 9% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $99,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $1,488,000 ($1,080 psf, 1,237–1,377 sq ft; 5 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,214 psf (range $1,062–1,438); 11% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $185,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Bukit Gombak MRT about 340 m, Bukit Batok MRT about 830 m; closer than 58 of 94 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest Dazhong Primary School about 270 m; more than 62 of 94 similar developments (the same as 10). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 150 m), more than 70 of 94 similar developments (the same as 11); nearest hawker centre Bukit Batok West Hawker Centre about 850 m; nearest park Bukit Batok Town Park about 420 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Hillhaven, 13 new sales, about 1,660 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 39 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 126 new sales and 331 resales (457 purchases); new sales were 27.6% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 331 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 32 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 331 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 342 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−3.2%). Planning-area private resales −2.8%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
